title: Chinese automakers are following Tesla’s bet that robots are the next big profit machine
snippet: Technical progress has encouraged a new batch of companies to jump in on the promise of profits from humanoid robots. And they're all Chinese automakers.

title: How Amazon is helping communities impacted by the Nepal flash floods
snippet: Amazon is working with aid organizations to help communities recover following flooding and landslides along the Nepal border.

title: Affirm CEO: American Consumers Are Healthy
snippet: Affirm CEO Max Levchin joins Bloomberg Businessweek Daily to discuss the company's recent earnings report, including an upbeat revenue outlook as the short-term loan company sees its most profitable quarter on record. Levchin also discusses recent partnerships, e-commerce growth, and the state of the consumer, saying Affirm customers are "healthy, paying us back on time, and shopping." He speaks with Tim Stenovec and Lisa Mateo. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: AI gold rush draws crypto firms away from Bitcoin
snippet: The price of Bitcoin has risen in August but is still far below its peak almost a year ago - and companies are refitting their mines.
